answer.rationale: Contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew, so the default is renewal not a free option — I need to compare the two paths now. Finance requires an 18% cost cut, so I need the lever that actually moves unit cost. memory_c2 is the one that documents a primary-vendor switch cutting unit cost sharply, so I want to verify it before betting on a switch. I am deliberately stopping short of committing to a full move; the right move this cycle is a small, guarded pilot with the low-cost vendor to confirm the cost gap and delivery reliability before scaling, with the incumbent retained on a short bridge. That keeps the 94% throughput intact while I gather evidence for the next review. A 18% TCO reduction targeted via primary-source resourcing, single-point delivery risk contained by keeping the incumbent warm.
